name: hard fat + phenylephrine
uses: Uses temporarily shrinks hemorrhoidal tissue temporarily relieves the itching, burning and discomfort associated with hemorrhoids
otcwarn: Ask a doctor before use if you have heart disease thyroid disease high blood pressure diabetes trouble urinating due to an enlarged prostate gland Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are presently taking a prescription drug for high blood pressure or depression. Stop use and ask a doctor if bleeding occurs condition worsens or does not improve within 7 days
